mapper.update: UPDATE content_blog SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM content_blog WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND category IS NOT NULL AND category <> '' AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY category

SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM content_blog WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND category IS NOT NULL AND category <> '' AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'PUBLISHED'
AND (author_id = #{authorId} OR visibility IN ('FAMILY', 'PUBLIC'))
AND visibility = 'PUBLIC'
GROUP BY category
mapper.update: UPDATE content_blog SET category = #{newName} WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND category = #{oldName} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE content_blog SET category = CONCAT(#{newPrefix}, SUBSTRING(category, CHAR_LENGTH(#{oldPrefix}) + 1)) WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND category LIKE CONCAT(#{oldPrefix}, '%') AND deleted = 0
UPDATE content_blog SET category = NULL WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND category = #{category} AND deleted = 0
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM content_blog WHERE family_id = #{familyId} AND category = #{category} AND deleted = 0
